nations.name: Egypt
nations.squad: Final 21 named 7 November; in Doha since 15 November
players: Ahmed Safwat: captain and creator, attacking midfielder (Zamalek). Best player of the U-17 Gulf Cup in Qatar this autumn.

matches.story: Egypt played from the 23rd minute with ten men and still pulled a goal back: Ziad Saudi's strike from distance, with the keeper at full stretch. Captain Ahmed Safwat started in midfield.
matches.scout: Saudi's goal is the clip clubs will ask for: a clean strike under pressure, in a match Egypt were chasing a man down.
keyNumbers: minutes in which Greece scored twice after the break
points: Qatar on Sunday is a must-not-lose

analysis.h: The red card shaped the match
analysis.p: Egypt lost a player to a second yellow card in the 23rd minute and held 0-0 to half-time. After the break Greece made the extra player count, scoring twice in eight minutes.

analysis.h: Still a threat with ten men
analysis.p: Ziad Saudi's strike from outside the box at 71 minutes kept the match alive. A clean finish under pressure, chasing the game a man down, is exactly the kind of moment clubs ask to see.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Egypt are on zero points with two matches left. With the eight best third-placed teams also going through, a win against hosts Qatar on Sunday keeps the round of 32 in Egypt's hands.

nations.name: Mozambique
nations.route: Play-off: 1-1 with Ethiopia, won 5-4 on penalties
players: Diego Elias Pelembe: midfielder and captain, two goals at the U-17 AFCON.
Alírio Cuna Júnior: winger (Black Bulls), two goals against Denmark.

goals.how: Finish from the edge of the box after a break; assist Chausson Nhabanga
Sliding finish at the near post on the counter
Into an empty net after the keeper was beaten

matches.story: Africa's first win of the tournament, in Mozambique's first U-17 World Cup match. They led inside four minutes and were 3-0 up at half-time. Captain Diego Elias Pelembe ran midfield with Khensane Machel and Valentim Pacane. Mozambique top Group C after Australia beat Argentina 2-0.
matches.scout: Machel and Cuna Júnior are the names to follow against Argentina on Sunday: both scored from fast breaks against a European side.

analysis.h: Built to hurt teams on the break
analysis.p: Two of the first three goals came from fast breaks: Machel finishing from the edge of the box four minutes in, then Cuna Júnior sliding in at the near post on a counter. Denmark had to commit players forward and Mozambique punished the space behind them.

analysis.h: The game was won before half-time
analysis.p: Goals at 4, 32 and 44 minutes meant Mozambique could manage the second half, and they still added a fourth in added time. For a side in its first U-17 World Cup, controlling a European opponent for 90 minutes is the headline.
Machel, Cuna Júnior and Mubai all scored: the threat is spread across the team, which makes Mozambique harder to plan against.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Three points and a +4 goal difference put Mozambique top of Group C. The group winners, the runners-up and the eight best third-placed teams reach the round of 32, so another result against Argentina or Australia would all but secure a place. Argentina lost 2-0 to Australia and must now come at Mozambique, which suits a side this quick on the break.

nations.name: Uganda
nations.route: Play-off: 2-2 with Ghana, won 8-7 on penalties

matches.story: A hard opener against an Asian side that scored early. Uganda were 1-0 down at half-time and created a clear chance of their own before Korea pulled away.
matches.scout: Ecuador on Sunday is the match that decides Uganda's group, and the one to watch their squad in.
keyNumbers: at half-time: still in the match
matches left: Ecuador and New Caledonia

analysis.h: An early goal set the tone
analysis.p: Korea Republic scored in the 8th minute and Uganda spent the match chasing. They stayed in it until half-time at 1-0 and created a clear chance of their own before a deflected shot made it 2-0 early in the second half.

analysis.h: What it means for the group
analysis.p: Uganda are bottom of Group B after the opener, but two matches remain against Ecuador and New Caledonia, and the eight best third-placed teams also reach the round of 32. Ecuador on Sunday is the match that decides their tournament.
